findings.highlight: the lobby slowly wrapped in darkness.
findings.evidenceJa: ロビーはゆっくりと闇に包まれていく
findings.governingReading: The lobby is gradually enveloped in darkness.
findings.explanation: The lobby clause lacks its auxiliary.

findings.highlight: we even gained an ally to choose the path to fight
findings.evidenceJa: 協力者を得てまで“戦う”という道を選んだ筈
findings.governingReading: They chose fighting even if it required obtaining an ally; this branch has refused cooperation.
findings.explanation: Seeking cooperation becomes an ally already gained.

findings.highlight: so that we can deceive ourselves.
findings.governingReading: 互い marks the reciprocal object of the two people’s bluff.
findings.explanation: Deceiving one another becomes deceiving themselves.

findings.highlight: The match should be made in an instant.
findings.evidenceJa: 戦いは、おそらく一合の下に決する
findings.governingReading: 決する concerns deciding the outcome, probably in a single clash.
findings.explanation: A fight decided in one exchange becomes a match made.

findings.highlight: the clouds block my hands like a wall.
findings.evidenceJa: 雲は壁のように行く手を阻む
findings.governingReading: 行く手 is the onward path in the wall/cloud image.
findings.explanation: Clouds block hands instead of the way ahead.
